description: Repeated failed staff logins for a non-existent user hit Ghost's brute-force limiter (attempt 6).

headers.cache-control: no-cache, private, no-store, must-revalidate, max-stale=0, post-check=0, pre-check=0

errors.message: Too many login attempts. Please wait 10 minutes before trying again, or reset your password.

notes: Ghost's Admin API with an integration key had no rate limit locally; this is the only 429 the local instance produces. The owner account is not affected.
